title: Mohamed ke alamdar
body:
zakhmi huwe sajde mein mohamed ke alamdar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil mein hai mushkil kusha nabiyon ke madadgaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar zakhmi hua dard se hai jism mein larza
sar thaame huwe haathon se kehte hai ye maula
khoon rukta nahi kaise karun doosra sajda
hai bheega hua khoon mein ab saara musalla
bekhuaf chale maut se karte huwe takraar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
roze mein kiya zarbe sitam maar ke zakhmi
to saara badan zard hai shiddat se zeher ki
ghash aate hai reh reh ke ye haalat hai ali ki
bistar pe tadapte hai nahi chain zara bhi
darwaze pe rote hai khade saare wafadaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha baba ko seene se laga kar
na jao hamay chod ke mai waari hoon tum par
sadma na yateemi ka utha paungi dil par
aayi thi madine se yahan amma ko kho kar
nazdeek bahot eid hai ye soohiye ek baar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh ho kyun baba hassan ko ye batao
aankhon ko zara kholo to chehre ko utha lo
har din ki tarha seene se ab mujhko lagao
takleef agar zakhm mein zyada hai batao
qurban mai jaan aap pe karne ko hoon tayyar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir se ek pal na juda hote thay baba
tu jaan se zyada hai meri kehte thay baba
bosay meri gardan ke bahot lete thay baba
pani mujhe uth uth ke pila dete thay baba
ay sher e khuda utho karo uth ke mujhe pyar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kone mein abbas khade rote hai baba
aankhein hai chadi ghaiz se aur surkh hai chehra
sar kaat ke rakh dega wo muljim ke pisar ka
hai waqt e qaza kehte hai shabbir se maula
ab tere hawale hai mera ghazi o jarrar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha shor qamar kufe mein maare gaye hyder
ay shadman tha charon taraf hashr ka manzar
sar peeto karo girya rakho khaak saron par
sab kehte thay ye maula ke darwaze pe aa kar
aa jaaye qaza maula ke bin jeena hai bekaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
author: Qamar Buknalvi
